subject: Akira Health — implementation initialization & owner routing
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Elaine Park <elaine@akirahealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@akirahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jul 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Akira Health — implementation initialization & owner routing

Team / Elaine,

Great to have Akira Health across the line — they signed the standard Dedicated + Private deployment package (SOW attached). Quick summary so CS has the runway: 

- Committed go-live model: redwood-llm-v2 (pinned).
- Deployment: Private VPC (customer-managed VPC peering).
- Pilot window: 2 weeks (contract start 2028-08-01, pilot target 2028-08-15).
- SLA expectations: target p95 inference latency <= 200ms, throughput ~200 requests/minute during business hours; burst plan agreed for first 30 days.
- Security requirements: SOC 2 type II evidence requested, Okta SSO (SAML) for admin access, customer expects audit logs to be retained 90 days.
- Data handling: no long-term storage of PII on our hosted infra; full encryption with customer KMS (they will supply key material).
- Procurement: PO in process — procurement@akirahealth.com is on copy. Deal id AKR-2028-0731.

Attachments: Akira_SOW_v2.pdf (primary SOW), Okta_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (requested by Akira IT).

Proposed internal owners (sales recommends):
- Primary CS steward / kickoff lead: Marissa Cole
- Security & compliance lead (initial): Karthik Iyer
- Sales escalation / exec sponsor: Vivek Kulkarni

Marissa / Karthik — can you confirm ownership and whether the proposed pilot cadence (tech sync + runbook review week of July 24, formal kickoff week of July 31) works for your teams? Elaine — if those ranges look ok from your side please confirm so we can lock calendar invites.

Next steps my side: Ill upload the signed SOW to the HubSpot deal and push the DocuSign return copy to the shared drive link below.

Thanks,
Vivek
--
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0148

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@akirahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jul 2028 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Akira Health — implementation initialization & owner routing

Thanks Vivek — happy to take primary stewardship.

Ill own the kickoff scheduling and high-level onboarding checklist. Preliminary notes from my side: 
- I want a short 45-minute technical sync (Redwood infra + Akira networking) before we share runbook. Attendees: Akira infra lead, our SRE, Karthik for security answers.
- Risk: customer requires customer-managed KMS; we need details on key rotation and whether Akira will allow a staging key during the pilot.
- Success metrics for the pilot: 1) < 200ms p95 for 95% of requests, 2) 5k tokens/day processed reliably for 14 days, 3) no security exceptions on SOC2 artifact checklist.

I propose these immediate pre-kickoff tasks (to be completed before 07/31 kickoff):
1) Karthik: confirm SOC2 evidence we can share and any redlines on Okta flows (target: 07/18).
2) Akira: supply KMS contact and PO number (Elaine / procurement).
3) Sales: upload finalized SOW and create shared Drive folder (Vivek) (done uploaded to HubSpot link).

If that looks right Ill send an invite for the tech sync 07/24-07/26 window (45 mins). Ill draft a 90-minute kickoff agenda for 07/31 and share for comments.

Marissa
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Thanks for the clear summary — this aligns with our expectations. A few notes from Akira IT / procurement: 
- PO is in the final sign-off stage; procurement expects to issue PO #AK-78412 by 07/25.
- Okta team will need the SAML metadata endpoint and a list of test accounts; our Okta admin (copying: procurement) will coordinate.
- KMS: we will provide a staging key for the pilot and the production key before go-live. I will send the contact details by end of day 07/21.

We can do the tech sync on 07/25 at 10:00 AM PT and kickoff on 07/31 as proposed. Please send calendar invites and the preliminary agenda.

Marissa / Vivek — quick follow-up from security side.

- I will prepare the minimal SOC2 artifact packet we can share (system description, control matrix, last auditor letter). Expect to upload to the shared Drive folder by 07/18.
- For Okta SAML: I need the list of Redwood redirect URIs and the admin test account naming convention (Marissa, can you confirm who from SRE will be on the tech sync?).
- On KMS: staging key is fine for pilot; we need written confirmation of rotation windows (document in Drive). If Akira can confirm the staging key expiry > 30 days after pilot end that avoids mid-pilot rekey.

Ill also create two short runbooks: (1) emergency rollback (how we revert routing if latency spikes), (2) token limit handling for burst. Ill circulate drafts by 07/27 so you have time to review before kickoff.

- Karthik
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
